title: Green facile fabrication of halogen-free flame-retardant ABS with high mechanical performance

The Ce@APP/DP endowed the ABS with excellent fire safety, which achieved the LOI of 28.6% and UL-94 V0 rating. Furthermore, the pHRR and pSPR of flame-retardant ABS composite were significantly reduced.
